## 3. SET DIRECTORIES
```{r setup-paths, include=FALSE}
  ######################### SET OUTPUT DIRECTORY  ######################### 
graphics_dir <- file.path("Results/Graphics")
tables_dir   <- file.path("Results/Tables") 
procdata_dir <- file.path("Results/Processed_data")

dirs <- c(graphics_dir, tables_dir, procdata_dir)

# Create directories if they don't exist
invisible(
  sapply(
    dirs,
    function(d) {
      if (!dir.exists(d)) {
        dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      }
    }
  )
)
## Print confirmation

cat("- Graphics: ", graphics_dir, "\n")
cat("- Tables:   ", tables_dir, "\n")
cat("- Proc:     ", procdata_dir, "\n")
```

## 4. READ IN FILES
```{r read-couts, message=FALSE}
  ######################### LOAD featureCounts WHOLE GENOME ALIGNMENT ######################### 
library(readr)
featcount <- read_tsv("../HvIM/Data_Repository/featcount.txt", skip = 1)
count_cols <- colnames(featcount)[7:ncol(featcount)]
read.count <- featcount %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(count_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()
```

## 6. EXTRACT H IM UM
```{r setup-count-data}
## Columns to DROP: IT(1:4,13:16), UT(10:12,22:25) → KEEP 5-9,17-21,26-30
keep_cols <- c(5:9, 17:21, 26:30)
ImvHvUM <- read.count[, keep_cols]
colnames(ImvHvUM)  # Confirm order
cat("📊 Counts loaded:", nrow(ImvHvUM), "genes x", ncol(ImvHvUM), "samples\n")

sample_info<- data.frame(
  row.names = c("H-107", "H-108", "H-109", "H-110", "H-111", 
                "IM-206", "IM-207", "IM-208", "IM-209", "IM-210", 
                "UM-204", "UM-208", "UM-213", "UM-214", "UM-215"),
  Groups = factor(c(rep("H",5), rep("IM",5), rep("UM",5)), levels=c("UM","IM","H")),
  Condition = factor(c(rep("Infected",10), rep("Uninfected",5)))
)
stopifnot(all(rownames(sample_info) == colnames(ImvHvUM))) #checks

ImvHvUM_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(as.matrix(ImvHvUM)), "GeneID")
```

## 7. SET COLORS AND THRESHOLDS
```{r Colors}
colors <- c("H"="blue", "IM"="hotpink", "UM"="black", "UT"="lightgreen", "IT"="purple")
pad <- 0.05
lfc_thresh <- 1.0
```

## 8. RUN DESeq
```{r DESeq-run, message=FALSE}
  ######################### RUN DESEQ  ######################### 
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = ImvHvUM,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ Groups)

## Prefilter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]
## UM reference
dds$Groups <- relevel(dds$Groups, ref = "UM")
cat("📊 Counts loaded:", nrow(dds), "genes x", ncol(dds), "samples\n")

## Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)
## Save full DESeq object
#saveRDS(dds, file.path(procdata_dir, "dds_IM_H_UM.rds"))
sf <- round(sizeFactors(dds), 3)
kable(data.frame(Sample=names(sf), SizeFactor=sf), caption="Size Factors")
```

## 9. DESEQ Result Comparisons
```{r DESeq-results-summary}
  ######################### RESULTS   ######################### 
res_IM_UM <- results(dds, name = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", alpha = 0.05)
res_H_UM  <- results(dds, name = "Groups_H_vs_UM", alpha = 0.05)

# Define your comparisons in a list
comparisons <- list(
  "IM vs UM" = res_IM_UM,
  "H vs UM"  = res_H_UM
)

cat("Differentially Expressed Genes (padj < 0.05):\n")
cat("-----------------------------------------\n")

for (cmp_name in names(comparisons)) {
  res <- comparisons[[cmp_name]]
  
  total <- sum(res$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  up    <- sum(res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  down  <- sum(res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("%-10s: Total = %4d | Up = %4d | Down = %4d\n",
              cmp_name, total, up, down))
}
```

## 14. LFC SHRINKAGE + ARRANGEMENT + CLEAN
```{r DESeq-results-lfc, message=FALSE}
#########################  DESeq2 LFC Shrinkage & Cleaning  #########################
# Helper function to safely run lfcShrink with fallback
safe_lfcShrink <- function(dds, coef_name, contrast_vec) {
  tryCatch({
    lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef_name, type = "apeglm")
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste0("apeglm failed for ", coef_name, ", using normal: ", e$message))
    lfcShrink(dds, contrast = contrast_vec, type = "normal")
  })
}

# Run LFC shrinkage for comparisons
lfc_H_UM  <- safe_lfcShrink(dds, "Groups_H_vs_UM",  c("Groups", "H", "UM"))
lfc_IM_UM <- safe_lfcShrink(dds, "Groups_IM_vs_UM", c("Groups", "IM", "UM"))

# Convert to data.frame, add Gene column, filter out NA padj, and arrange
clean_res <- function(lfc_obj) {
  as.data.frame(lfc_obj) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "TAIR") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    arrange(padj)
}

res_H_UM_df  <- clean_res(lfc_H_UM)
res_IM_UM_df <- clean_res(lfc_IM_UM)

#########################  Split DEGs into up/down and map symbols/ENTREZ #########################  
split_DEGs <- function(df, lfc_thresh = 1) {
  df %>%
    mutate(direction = case_when(
      log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh  ~ "UP",
      log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh ~ "DOWN",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )) %>%
    filter(direction != "NS") %>%
    mutate(
      symbol = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "SYMBOL",
                      keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first"),
      entrez = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "ENTREZID",
                      keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first")
    )
}

deg_H <- split_DEGs(res_H_UM_df, lfc_thresh)
deg_IM <- split_DEGs(res_IM_UM_df, lfc_thresh)

deg_H_up   <- deg_H   %>% filter(direction == "UP")
deg_H_down <- deg_H   %>% filter(direction == "DOWN")
deg_IM_up  <- deg_IM  %>% filter(direction == "UP")
deg_IM_down<- deg_IM  %>% filter(direction == "DOWN")


#########################   Summary table for all contrasts #########################  

count_DEGs_summary <- function(df, lfc_thresh = 1, pad = 0.05) {
  total <- sum(df$padj < pad, na.rm = TRUE)
  lfc1  <- sum(df$padj < pad & abs(df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
  up    <- sum(df$padj < pad & df$log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
  down  <- sum(df$padj < pad & df$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(n_DEG = total, n_LFC1 = lfc1, up = up, down = down)
}

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  count_DEGs_summary(res_IM_UM_df, lfc_thresh)  %>% mutate(contrast = "IM_vs_UM"),
  count_DEGs_summary(res_H_UM_df, lfc_thresh)   %>% mutate(contrast = "H_vs_UM")
) %>%
  select(contrast, everything())

summary_tbl


######################### Optional: export results to Excel #########################
export_list <- list(
  "H_vs_UM_results" = res_H_UM_df,
  "IM_vs_UM_results" = res_IM_UM_df,
  "H_vs_UM_DEGs"    = deg_H,
  "IM_vs_UM_DEGs"   = deg_IM
)
# writexl::write_xlsx(export_list, path = file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_results.xlsx"))
# cat("✅ DESeq2 results saved as Excel at:", file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_results.xlsx"), "\n")

#########################  MA Plots  #########################

plot_DEGs_MA <- function(lfc_obj, main_title, pad = 0.05, lfc_thresh = 1) {
  plotMA(lfc_obj, ylim = c(-5,5), alpha = pad, main = main_title)
  sig <- lfc_obj$padj < pad & abs(lfc_obj$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh
  points(
    log2(lfc_obj$baseMean[sig] + 1),
    lfc_obj$log2FoldChange[sig],
    col = "red",
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.6
  )
}

plot_DEGs_MA(lfc_H_UM, "H vs UM", pad = 0.05, lfc_thresh = lfc_thresh)
plot_DEGs_MA(lfc_IM_UM, "IM vs UM", pad = 0.05, lfc_thresh = lfc_thresh)
```

```{r deg-heatmap}
#PHEATMAP
  p_deg <- pheatmap(
    deg_mat,
    scale = "row",  # Z-score per gene for DE visualization
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdYlBu")))(100),
```

```{r H v UM DEGS}
######################### Prepare DEG Tables #########################
# deg_H, deg_IM, split into UP/DOWN via split_DEGs()

######################### Shared DEGs for haustoria candidates #########################
shared_tair <- intersect(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)

deg_shared <- deg_H %>%
  filter(TAIR %in% shared_tair) %>%
  left_join(
    dplyr::select(deg_IM, TAIR, log2FoldChange_IM = log2FoldChange, padj_IM = padj),
    by = "TAIR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(avg_lfc = (log2FoldChange + coalesce(log2FoldChange_IM, 0)) / 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_lfc))

######################### Split UP/DOWN for heatmaps#########################
H_UP  <- deg_H %>% filter(direction == "UP")
H_DOWN <- deg_H %>% filter(direction == "DOWN")
IM_UP  <- deg_IM %>% filter(direction == "UP")
IM_DOWN <- deg_IM %>% filter(direction == "DOWN")

cat("DE Genes (|LFC| ≥", lfc_thresh, ", padj <", padj_thresh, "):\n")
cat("- H vs UM:    ", nrow(deg_H), " (UP:", nrow(H_UP), " DOWN:", nrow(H_DOWN), ")\n")
cat("- IM vs UM:   ", nrow(deg_IM), " (UP:", nrow(IM_UP), " DOWN:", nrow(IM_DOWN), ")\n")
cat("- Shared:     ", nrow(deg_shared), "\n")

######################### Export Excel workbook #########################
deg_workbook <- list(
  H_vs_UM_All   = deg_H %>% arrange(padj),
  H_vs_UM_UP    = H_UP,
  H_vs_UM_DOWN  = H_DOWN,
  IM_vs_UM_All  = deg_IM %>% arrange(padj),
  IM_vs_UM_UP   = IM_UP,
  IM_vs_UM_DOWN = IM_DOWN,
  Shared        = deg_shared
)

#write_xlsx(deg_workbook, file.path(tables_dir, "DE_genes_all_directions.xlsx"))

######################### Summary stats table #########################
summary_stats <- tibble(
  Category = c("H vs UM UP", "H vs UM DOWN", "IM vs UM UP", "IM vs UM DOWN", "Shared"),
  n_genes = c(nrow(H_UP), nrow(H_DOWN), nrow(IM_UP), nrow(IM_DOWN), nrow(deg_shared))
)

######################### overlap and unique DEGs #########################
overlap_genes <- intersect(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)
unique_H <- setdiff(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)
unique_IM <- setdiff(deg_IM$TAIR, deg_H$TAIR)

comparison_tbl <- tibble(
  Category = c("H_vs_IM_overlap", "Unique_H_vs_UM", "Unique_IM_vs_UM"),
  n_genes  = c(length(overlap_genes), length(unique_H), length(unique_IM))
) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_of_H  = round(100 * n_genes / nrow(deg_H), 1),
    percent_of_IM = round(100 * n_genes / nrow(deg_IM), 1)
  )

# Print summary
summary_stats
comparison_tbl
```

```{r}
## GO ENRICHMENT
tair_list <- list(
  IM_UP   = IM_UP$TAIR[!is.na(IM_UP$TAIR)],
  H_UP    = H_UP$TAIR[!is.na(H_UP$TAIR)],
  IM_DOWN = IM_DOWN$TAIR[!is.na(IM_DOWN$TAIR)],
  H_DOWN  = H_DOWN$TAIR[!is.na(H_DOWN$TAIR)]
)

## SINGLE COMBINED DOTPLOT
go_compare <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = tair_list,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
  keyType = "TAIR",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10
)
p_go_dot <- dotplot(go_compare, showCategory = 10, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) + 
  ggtitle("GO BP Terms: 4-way Comparison (IM_UP/H_UP/IM_DOWN/H_DOWN)")
print(p_go_dot)

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GO_BP_4way_combined_dotplot.png"), 
       plot = p_go_dot, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved GO BP 4-way combined dotplot\n")

## SUMMARY
go_summary <- tibble(
  Category = c("IM_UP", "H_UP", "IM_DOWN", "H_DOWN"),
  n_genes = c(nrow(IM_UP), nrow(H_UP), nrow(IM_DOWN), nrow(H_DOWN))
)
print(go_summary)


## Individual results for exports
ego_list <- list()
for(category in names(tair_list)) {
  tair_clean <- tair_list[[category]]
  if(length(tair_clean) > 10) {
    ego_list[[category]] <- enrichGO(
      gene = tair_clean,
      OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
      keyType = "TAIR",
      ont = "BP", 
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
      minGSSize = 10
    )
  } else {
    ego_list[[category]] <- NULL
  }
}

## Assign for backward compatibility
ego_IMup   <- ego_list$IM_UP
ego_Hup    <- ego_list$H_UP
ego_IMdown <- ego_list$IM_DOWN
ego_Hdown  <- ego_list$H_DOWN

cat("✅ GO objects assigned: ego_IMup, ego_Hup, ego_IMdown, ego_Hdown\n")
```

```{r}
## COMPLETE KEGG (IM_UP, H_UP, IM_DOWN, H_DOWN)
entrez_list <- list(
  IM_UP   = IM_UP$entrez[!is.na(IM_UP$entrez)],
  H_UP    = H_UP$entrez[!is.na(H_UP$entrez)],
  IM_DOWN = IM_DOWN$entrez[!is.na(IM_DOWN$entrez)],
  H_DOWN  = H_DOWN$entrez[!is.na(H_DOWN$entrez)]
)

## SINGLE COMBINED KEGG DOTPLOT (all 4 categories)
kegg_compare <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = entrez_list,
  fun = "enrichKEGG",
  organism = "ath",
  keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
  pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
  use_internal_data = FALSE
)

p_kegg_dot <- dotplot(kegg_compare, showCategory = 10, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) + 
  ggtitle("KEGG Pathways: 4-way Comparison (IM_UP/H_UP/IM_DOWN/H_DOWN)")
print(p_kegg_dot)

#ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "KEGG_4way_combined_dotplot.png"), 
#      plot = p_kegg_dot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved KEGG 4-way combined dotplot\n")

# Keep individual results for exports (run enrichKEGG separately)
kegg_results <- list()
for(category in names(entrez_list)) {
  entrez_clean <- entrez_list[[category]]
  if(length(entrez_clean) > 10) {
    kegg_results[[category]] <- enrichKEGG(
      gene = entrez_clean,
      organism = "ath",
      keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
      pvalueCutoff = pad, qvalueCutoff = pad,
      minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500,
      use_internal_data = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    kegg_results[[category]] <- NULL
  }
}


## COMPLETE EXPORTS
kegg_xlsx <- lapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(is.null(x)) data.frame() else x@result)
kegg_xlsx$Summary <- tibble(
  Category = names(kegg_results),
  n_genes_input = sapply(entrez_list, length),
  n_KEGG_terms = sapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(is.null(x)) 0 else nrow(x@result))
)
kegg_xlsx$KEGG_Compare <- as.data.frame(kegg_compare@compareClusterResult)

#write_xlsx(kegg_xlsx, file.path(tables_dir, "KEGG_4way_complete.xlsx"))


## FULL GO+KEGG COMBINED
full_export <- list(
  GO_BP_IM_UP   = ego_IMup@result,
  GO_BP_H_UP    = ego_Hup@result,
  GO_BP_IM_DOWN = ego_IMdown@result,
  GO_BP_H_DOWN  = ego_Hdown@result,
  
  # KEGG individuals
  KEGG_IM_UP    = kegg_results$IM_UP@result,
  KEGG_H_UP     = kegg_results$H_UP@result,
  KEGG_IM_DOWN  = kegg_results$IM_DOWN@result,
  KEGG_H_DOWN   = kegg_results$H_DOWN@result,
  
  # KEGG combined
  KEGG_4way_Compare = kegg_compare@compareClusterResult,
  
  # Summary
  Summary = tibble(
    Category = names(entrez_list),
    n_genes = sapply(entrez_list, length),
    n_GO_terms = c(nrow(ego_IMup@result), nrow(ego_Hup@result), nrow(ego_IMdown@result), nrow(ego_Hdown@result)),
    n_KEGG_terms = sapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(is.null(x)) 0 else nrow(x@result))
  )
)

cat("- KEGG_4way_combined_similarity.png\n")
cat("- KEGG_4way_complete.xlsx (incl. compareCluster)\n")
cat("- COMPLETE_GO_KEGG_4way.xlsx\n")
```

```{r UP-Green-GO-genes}
# Extract H results
top_H_up <- ego_H_up@result %>% 
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, Count) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "H-UP")

# Extract same GO terms from H-DOWN
H_down_same <- ego_H_down@result %>%
  filter(Description %in% 
           top_H_up$Description) %>%
  select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, Count) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "H-DOWN")

#COMBINE
go_mirror <- bind_rows(top_H_up, H_down_same)

# Convert GeneRatio to numeric
go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(
    GeneRatio_num = sapply(strsplit(GeneRatio, "/"),
      function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2])
    )
  )


go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(
    GeneRatio_plot = ifelse(Direction == "H-UP",
                            -GeneRatio_num, #the - switches the bar side
                            GeneRatio_num)
  )


go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(order_val = ifelse(Direction == "H-UP",
                            -GeneRatio_num,
                            GeneRatio_num))

go_mirror$Description <- stringr::str_wrap(go_mirror$Description, width = 35)
H_up   <- go_mirror %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "H-UP")
H_down <- go_mirror %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "H-DOWN")

# H UP REGULATED PLOT 
p_tornado <- ggplot() +
# H-UP bars
  geom_col(
    data = H_up,
aes(x = GeneRatio_plot, y = reorder(Description, Count), fill = Count),
    width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightpink",
    high = "deeppink",
    name = "H-UP Gene Count",
  guide = guide_colorbar(order = 1)
  ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + # reset scale for second gradient
  
 ## H DOWN
geom_col(data = H_down, aes(x = GeneRatio_plot, y = Description, fill = Count), width = 0.7,) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "thistle",
    high = "purple",
    name = "H-DOWN Gene Count",
  guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2)
  ) +
     # center reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  
    #count labels on bars
  geom_text(
    data = go_mirror,
    aes(x = GeneRatio_plot, y = Description, label = Count),
    size = 3,
      color = "black",
    hjust = ifelse(go_mirror$Direction == "H-UP", 1.1, -0.1)
  ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
    labels = abs,
    name = "Gene Ratio"
  ) +
    labs(y = "GO Biological Process", 
       title = "Top GO Terms Enriched in UP-Regulated Haustoriated Cells\nand Their Representation in Down-Regulated Genes") +
  theme(
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
) +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
print(p_tornado)

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "mirrored_GO_H_UP_comparison.png"),
  p_tornado,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
  guide = guide_colorbar(order = 1)
  ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + # reset scale for second gradient
  
  ## IM UP
geom_col(data = IM_up, aes(x = GeneRatio_plot, y = Description, fill = Count), width = 0.7,) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#FFD6D6",
    high = "#FF6B6B",
    name = "IM-UP Gene Count",
  guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2)
  ) +
    # center reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  #count labels on bars
  geom_text(
    data = go_mirror,
    aes(x = GeneRatio_plot, y = Description, label = Count),
    size = 3,
      color = "black",
    hjust = ifelse(go_mirror$Direction == "IM-DOWN", 1.1, -0.1)
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = abs,
    name = "Gene Ratio"
  ) +
  labs(y = "GO Biological Process", 
       title = "Top GO Terms Enriched in Down-Regulated Mesophyll\nand Their Representation in Up-Regulated Genes") +
theme(
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
print(p_tornado)

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "mirrored_GO_IM_down_comparison.png"),
  p_tornado,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
## ---------------------------------------
## Load libraries
## ---------------------------------------

library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

## ---------------------------------------
## 1. Extract enrichment tables
## ---------------------------------------

up_res <- ego_H_up@result
down_res <- ego_H_down@result

up_res$Direction <- "H-UP"
down_res$Direction <- "H-DOWN"

## ---------------------------------------
## 2. Select top GO terms from H-UP
## ---------------------------------------

top_up <- up_res %>%
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  slice(1:10)

## ---------------------------------------
## 3. Extract the same GO terms from H-DOWN
## ---------------------------------------

down_match <- down_res %>%
  filter(ID %in% top_up$ID)

## ---------------------------------------
## 4. Combine datasets
## ---------------------------------------

go_mirror <- bind_rows(top_up, down_match)

## ---------------------------------------
## 5. Convert GeneRatio to numeric
## ---------------------------------------

go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(
    GeneRatio_num = sapply(strsplit(GeneRatio, "/"),
                           function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2]))
  )

## ---------------------------------------
## 6. Ensure p.adjust is numeric
## ---------------------------------------

go_mirror$p.adjust <- as.numeric(go_mirror$p.adjust)

## Calculate significance metric
go_mirror$negLogP <- -log10(go_mirror$p.adjust)

## ---------------------------------------
## 7. Clean GO term labels
## ---------------------------------------

go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(
    Description = str_replace(Description, "^positive regulation of ", "+ "),
    Description = str_replace(Description, "^negative regulation of ", "- "),
    Description = str_replace(Description, "^regulation of ", ""),
    Description = str_replace(Description, " process$", "")
  )

## Wrap long labels
go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(
    Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 35)
  )

## ---------------------------------------
## 8. Order GO terms by enrichment strength
## ---------------------------------------

go_mirror <- go_mirror %>%
  mutate(
    order_value = ifelse(Direction == "H-UP",
                         GeneRatio_num,
                         -GeneRatio_num)
  )

go_mirror$Description <- reorder(go_mirror$Description,
                                 go_mirror$order_value)

## ---------------------------------------
## 9. Create paired GO bubble plot
## ---------------------------------------

p_dot <- ggplot(go_mirror,
                aes(x = GeneRatio_num,
                    y = Description,
                    size = Count,
                    color = negLogP)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +

  facet_grid(Direction ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "skyblue",
    high = "red",
    name = "-log10(adj p-value)"
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3,10),
    name = "Gene Count"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Gene Ratio",
    y = "GO Biological Process",
    title = "GO Enrichment in Haustoriated Cells"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_dot)

## ---------------------------------------
## 10. Save the plot
## ---------------------------------------

ggsave(
  file.path(graphics_dir, "GO_bubble_Haustoria.png"),
  p_dot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
#  Filter H-specific upregulated genes

H_up_transporters <- green_H_up %>%        # green quadrant, H-specific UP
  filter(id %in% transporter_genes$id) %>% # intersect with transporter genes
  left_join(transporter_list, by = "id")    # add family info

#  Keep relevant columns and rank

H_up_transporters <- H_up_transporters %>%
  select(id, logFC_x, padj_x, Family) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC_x)) %>%                # rank by log fold change
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),                     # add rank
    log10_padj = -log10(padj_x),            # significance for plotting
    FC_label = round(logFC_x, 2)            # rounded fold change for table
  )
```

```{r}
# plot top transporters by fold change
top_n <- 10

plot_df <- H_up_transporters %>%
  slice(1:top_n) %>%
  mutate(id = fct_reorder(id, logFC_x)) # reorder bars


# Wrap legend labels to max 10 characters per line
fam_plot <- ggplot(H_up_transporters, 
                   aes(x = fct_reorder(id, logFC_x), 
                       y = logFC_x, 
                       size = -log10(padj_x), 
                       color = Family)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Top H-Upregulated Transporters in Haustoriated Cells",
    x = "Gene (ATG ID)",
    y = "log2 Fold Change",
    size = "-log10(padj)",
    color = "Transporter\nFamily" # title of legend
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 20)) + # wrap legend text
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6) # smaller legend text
  )

print(fam_plot)
# Save the plot
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "H_up_trans.png"),
       fam_plot,
       width = 10,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)

  select(id, logFC_x) %>%
  column_to_rownames("id") %>%
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
```
